d_and_a.source: Cisco 10-K acc. 0000858877-26-000132, DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization (as tagged; amortization of intangibles reported separately: 698/1028/916)

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2026 growth was 11.8% (acquisition/AI-networking driven); fade toward ~4% as growth normalizes; FY24-26 revenue CAGR ~8.5%

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2026 GAAP EBIT margin 24.3% (15368/63325); FY2024-25 were 22.6%/20.8%; hold ~24%

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2026 effective rate ~17.1% (1-13267/16009); rounded up modestly toward normalized

wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM Rf 4.86% (US 10Y, Treasury 2026-11-06) + beta ~1.0 (assumed, not looked up) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = ~9.3% cost of equity; debt ~$29.5B is a small share of capital at low after-tax cost (~4%), giving WACC ~9.0%

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below long-run nominal GDP growth and below the 4.86% risk-free rate

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 29,533 (LT noncurrent 19,372 + current debt 10,161) - cash 7,218 - ST investments 8,700; acc. 0000858877-26-000132
